name: Kuon
source:
Kuon used to study abroad, but now enters prestigious research academy in Japan on a secluded island. To pay his bills he starts a part-time job with one of campus facilities.

A fortune-teller appears before Kuon giving him meaningless prophecy and promising to meet again...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-january-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
久远曾经出国留学，如今进入日本一座偏僻岛屿上的知名研究院。为了支付生活费，他在校内某处设施找了份兼职。

一位占卜师出现在久远面前，给他留下毫无意义的预言，并约定再次见面……

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-january-1998.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
